same_trip_lock_contention.details: concurrentlyWithTripLock first holds SELECT ... FROM trip ... FOR UPDATE on a separate DriverManager connection, then requires observeTripSelect(2) before committing the blocker. Each request therefore reaches the real trip SELECT while the lock is held. RealJdbcProbe records pg_backend_pid() for opened application connections and assertIndependentTransactions(2) requires two distinct PostgreSQL backend PIDs. The bounded latches/futures provide deterministic release and completion signals.

global_request_collision_barrier.details: globalRequestCollisionRollsBackLoserTripAndReadsWinnerOnce uses pauseRequestInserts(2); both request INSERT executions must arrive before the barrier is released, preserving the staged-insert race proof.

clock_sampling_order_and_name.details: expiredReplaySamplesClockAfterRequestRowLockReturns uses separate executionSelect, executionSelectReturned, and clockQuery gates. The request-row completion gate is awaited before the clock-query gate, and RealJdbcProbe marks executionSelectReturned after statement execution. The test name describes ordering and does not assert exact timestamp equality.

http_auth_boundary.details: realServerRejectsForgedUserHeaderWithAuthenticationEnvelope sends java.net.http.HttpClient traffic to http://127.0.0.1:<random Spring server port>, supplies only a forged X-User-Id header, and asserts HTTP 401 plus AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED. It does not add shipped test authentication.
